title: EuroPriv-Bench: A Unified Pan-European De-identification Benchmark with Re-identification Risk Metrics
description: EuroPriv-Bench unifies European legal and clinical de-identification evaluation under a harmonized taxonomy and re-identification-risk metrics. This release contains the Paper 1 manuscript and its build sources. Validation follows an LLM-panel protocol, not native-speaker human review; panel outcomes must be reported separately.
